gaps.title: Get a warm introduction at each target organisation
gaps.why: A named insider who knows your work (D3 = 3) is the strongest single lift for a non-traditional candidate.

gaps.title: Turn a warm contact into a referral
gaps.why: An agreed referral (D3 = 4) also moves the interview band up one step.

gaps.title: Publish one verifiable proof-of-work piece for your target role family
gaps.why: Shipped, checkable work relevant to the role (D2 = 3) is what screeners look for when the résumé is non-traditional.

gaps.title: Tailor your résumé and story for each best-fit role
gaps.why: A tailored application (D7 = 4) is cheap and lifts every role you apply for.

gaps.title: Make your work findable
gaps.why: A hiring manager who searches for you should find your work (D5 = 3).

gaps.title: Build one thing each target organisation specifically values
gaps.why: An org-specific edge (D4 = 3) separates you from the general applicant pool.

gaps.title: Confirm your work rights or visa route for the role locations
gaps.why: Logistics (D6) often decide whether you are considered at all.
